Oneliner

Demonstrate CubeSat platform technologies.
Description

Test various systems that are expect to fly aboard a larger, future CubeSat to serve as a time capsule celebrating the school’s 200th anniversary.

Test retroreflectors used for ground tracking, solar panel deployment and measuring the radiation environment. The Michigan Bicentennial Archive aims to put a future cubesat in a Medium-Earth Orbit for 100 years.
Notes

Won free ULA launch slot.
